findings.title: Preferences applied partially / not reset on reload
findings.message: loadPreferences assigns m.displays and m.display before the final m.layouts = next. Because displays are applied in the middle of the load path, state is only partly applied if a later check fails. Earlier validation returns leave previous state, but display state is mutated before layouts; also, a file with an invalid Display leaves a stale m.display from a previous load, so reloading does not reset to the default.
findings.suggestion: Validate all fields first, then assign layouts, displays and display together; reset m.display to "both" when the saved value is empty or invalid.

finding.title: Display button bypasses modal guard
finding.message: The display button handler mutates m.displays and saves unconditionally, even when the gallery is disabled or the customizer modal is open. The context-menu path guards against this but the buttons do not, so the behaviours are inconsistent. Writing to disk on every click also does synchronous I/O in the UI callback.
finding.suggestion: Skip when m.customizer.Open (consistent with the context menu), and save only when something changed.
finding.evidence: Activate: func() { m.display = mode.id; clear(m.displays); m.savePreferences() }
